name: Claiming Arathi Basin
summary: An Alliance Brigadier General outside Arathi Basin asks you to bring three Arathi Basin Marks of Honor. The marks are the only thing named in this request.

faq.q: What does the Brigadier General ask for?
faq.answer: The Alliance Brigadier General asks you to bring three Arathi Basin Marks of Honor.

faq.q: Where do I bring the marks?
faq.answer: Bring the marks to an Alliance Brigadier General outside the battlegrounds.

faq.q: Who is asking for the marks?
faq.answer: An Alliance Brigadier General outside the battlegrounds asks for the marks.

angles.text: As an Alliance member, you are asked to bring three Arathi Basin Marks of Honor to an Alliance Brigadier General.

attribution: In-game quest text: Claiming Arathi Basin
